title: Organization key set, org-key-set/1 (DEC-0127)
description: One organization's signing keys for org-membership/1 attestations, under a monotonic revision, signed by the organization's root key over the RFC 8785 form of the set without sig (the register's org-key-set/1, DEC-0063). The person's estate pins the root (the estate record's organizations); the root signs nothing else. The set also certifies the administrators' signing passkeys (DEC-0129). One root per organization, even on a server that hosts many (MD-9 path (a)).

org.description: The organization whose root signs this set; the pin names the same.

revision.description: Rises with every set the root signs; a verifier refuses a lower revision than the one it applied, and the same revision with other bytes.

issuedAt.description: At least one key's window holds it (FAC-SEM-146).

notAfter.description: After notBefore (FAC-SEM-146). An attestation verifies under this key only when its issuedAt is at or after notBefore and before notAfter.

keys.description: The signing keys: each kid once, never the root's kid, at least one valid at issuedAt (FAC-SEM-146).

revoked.description: Kids revoked: absent from keys (FAC-SEM-146), and every attestation one of them signed is refused (key-revoked).

administrators.description: DEC-0129: the administrators' signing passkeys the root certifies, each a WebAuthn credential under a dedicated signing RP (sign.<domain>, DEC-0063); only one of them signs the organization's member list (org-authority/1, Fabric ADR-0178 point 2), never a key of keys. Each credentialId once, every RP ID a signing RP and every origin within it (FAC-SEM-146). Empty when the organization has no member list; a credential dropped from a later set signs nothing from that set on.

kid.description: The root key's kid, as the estate pinned it.

sig.description: The root key's Ed25519 signature (64 bytes, base64url without padding) over the UTF-8 RFC 8785 form of the set without sig.

ed25519X.description: A 32-byte Ed25519 public key, base64url without padding, canonical (the last character's two spare bits zero). Never a key of small order (DEC-0045, CT-29): the enum lists libsodium's seven encodings with the sign bit clear and set.
